name: EPIC 220590785
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 6.2 solar radii and 0.96 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220590785 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 6.188378 (16th-84th percentiles 5.987022-6.402244), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220590785 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.964292 (16th-84th percentiles 0.889112-1.047247), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220590785: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4876.748 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220590785 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2124.179688 (16th-84th percentiles 2067.089844-2183.457031), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.30 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 2,124 parsecs away, 6 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.96 solar masses and 6.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,877 K at its surface.
